meta.title: Pope Placeness
meta.welcome: An interactive map of where the popes were born, following the official Vatican list from St Peter to Leo XIV. Browse the map, open the list, or take the tour one pontificate at a time.
meta.list_note: In official Vatican order. 267 entries for 265 popes; Benedict IX appears three times.
